generator_cmd: printf '%s\n' "$plain" | perl -lpe '$_=join q( ),map{scalar reverse}split/ /,$_,-1' | tr -d '\n'  # perl: each space-separated word reversed
oracle_cmd: printf '%s\n' "$encoded" | python3 -I -c "import sys;print(' '.join(w[::-1] for w in sys.stdin.read().rstrip('\n').split(' ')),end='')"  # stdlib per-word reversal
